# filesystems

Shared NFS filesystems a project serves into its VPCs.

## GET /v1/filesystem-profiles

Operation `filesystem_profile_list`.

The profiles a filesystem can be created with.

Responses:

- `200`: successful operation, `application/json`: array of [FilesystemProfile](schemas.md#filesystemprofile)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)

## GET /v1/filesystems

Operation `filesystem_list`.

List a project's filesystems. The tenant is the project's.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | query | no | string (uuid) | Restrict to a single project. |
| `tenant` | query | no | string (uuid) | Restrict to a single tenant. |
| `limit` | query | no | integer (uint32) | Maximum rows to return. Defaults to 50 and is clamped to 500; zero is rejected rather than treated as "default". |
| `page_token` | query | no | string | Opaque cursor from the previous response's `next_page`. Valid only for the query that produced it. A token replayed against a different selector set or sort order, or modified in any way, is a `400`; it never silently restarts the listing. |
| `sort_by` | query | no | [NameOrIdSortMode](schemas.md#nameoridsortmode) | Order the collection is walked in. Defaults to `id_ascending`. Bound into the cursor, so it cannot change part-way through a walk. |

Responses:

- `200`: successful operation, `application/json`: [ResultsPage_for_Filesystem](schemas.md#resultspage_for_filesystem)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)

## POST /v1/filesystems

Operation `filesystem_create`.

Create a filesystem in a project. It is `creating` until its volume exists; poll it until `available`.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | query | no | string (uuid) | Restrict to a single project. |
| `tenant` | query | no | string (uuid) | Restrict to a single tenant. |

Request body (required): `application/json`: [NewFilesystem](schemas.md#newfilesystem)

Responses:

- `201`: successful creation, `application/json`: [Filesystem](schemas.md#filesystem)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)

## DELETE /v1/filesystems/{filesystem}

Operation `filesystem_delete`.

Delete a filesystem and every file in it. It is `deleting` until its volume is gone.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `filesystem` | path | yes | string (uuid) |  |

Responses:

- `202`: successfully enqueued operation, `application/json`: [Filesystem](schemas.md#filesystem)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)

## POST /v1/filesystems/{filesystem}/attachments

Operation `filesystem_attachment_create`.

Attach a filesystem to an instance in its VPC. The attachment is `attaching` until the VPC's gateways admit the instance's address.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `filesystem` | path | yes | string (uuid) |  |

Request body (required): `application/json`: [NewFilesystemAttachment](schemas.md#newfilesystemattachment)

Responses:

- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)

## DELETE /v1/filesystems/{filesystem}/attachments/{attachment}

Operation `filesystem_attachment_delete`.

Detach a filesystem. The instance loses access before the attachment goes; a mount inside the guest is not undone.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `attachment` | path | yes | string (uuid) |  |
| `filesystem` | path | yes | string (uuid) |  |

- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)

## POST /v1/filesystems/{filesystem}/resize

Operation `filesystem_resize`.

Grow or shrink a filesystem. It is `resizing` until the volume has the new capacity; a shrink below what it holds is refused and the filesystem returns to `available` at its old size.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `filesystem` | path | yes | string (uuid) |  |

Request body (required): `application/json`: [FilesystemResizeRequest](schemas.md#filesystemresizerequest)

Responses:

- `202`: successfully enqueued operation, `application/json`: [Filesystem](schemas.md#filesystem)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
